mission.name: InterestShield Original-Vision Production Restoration
mission.tagline: Recognizable assets, conserved cash, trustworthy comparisons. Task progress is not production readiness.
mission.northStar: Truth-first, hope-forward Velocity Banking education with correct math, explicit assumptions, private owner-scoped data, calm coaching, and no promised outcomes.

policies.notes: User approved autonomous implementation, verified pushes and recurring work. PR #256 stays draft while required production gates remain open. Do not auto-deploy, broaden access, start paid GPU jobs or mutate production data. Keep future implementation slices focused.

Address any exact-SHA CI failure without weakening gates. The stale native demo fixtures and software GPU locator screenshot issues have local regression proof; retain the 20-minute CI job cap.

When external art generation is blocked, advance R2/R3 with failing reproductions and no destructive scenario migration.

Plan a supported Expo SDK/dependency remediation for its 41 omit-dev-tree advisories and the 12 remaining web development-toolchain findings; distinguish build tools from device runtime, and do not force audit-proposed major downgrades.
The approved heartbeat runs every four hours. Continue bounded verified improvements on codex/restoration/asset-heroes and update PR #256.
